name: Mari El (Russia, 2006–2011)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and dark red with a dark red Mari solar ornament in the centre.
history: Second flag of the Republic of Mari El, adopted in 2006 with the stripes made equal and a central Mari ornament. It was replaced on 1 June 2011 by the present flag with the ornament at the hoist on a white field.
